teaser.en: Its white powder-puff flowers open only at night, and its light breathing roots have long served fishermen as net floats.
teaser.sw: Maua yake meupe yanayofanana na pamba ya poda huchanua usiku tu, na mizizi yake myepesi ya kupumulia imewatumikia wavuvi kwa muda mrefu kama vielelezo vya nyavu.
teaser.dg: Maruwage ga rangi nyereru, dza mafungu ga nyuzi laini, ganavugula usiku tu, na miziye ya kuphahira pumuzi iriyo phepheya avuvi kula kare anaihumira ili vimiya vielee.

summary.en: The mangrove apple is the tree of the outermost mangrove fringe, standing in open seawater on stout cone-shaped roots. Its wood, bark and even its roots have uses, from canoes and paddles to fishing-net floats.
summary.sw: Mlilana ni mti wa ukingo wa nje kabisa wa mikoko, unaosimama katika maji ya bahari yaliyo wazi juu ya mizizi minene yenye umbo la koni. Mbao zake, gome lake na hata mizizi yake vina matumizi, kuanzia mitumbwi na makasia hadi vielelezo vya nyavu za kuvulia.
summary.dg: *Mangrove apple* ni muhi wa kanda ya mikoko iriyo kure zaidi uphande wa bahari, unaoima kahi ya madzi ga bahari dzulu ya mizi miziho yenye ntsa iriyoima chocho. Mbaoze, gophare na hata miziye vina kazi, kula ngarawa na makasiya hadi kuelesa vimiya.

about.en:
The mangrove apple is a tree of about 10 metres with rounded, rather thick leaves. Around its base rises a forest of stout, cone-shaped breathing roots that poke up out of the mud and water, thicker and taller than those of the grey mangrove.

Its flowers are a sight worth staying late for. They are white powder puffs of long stamens that open at night and are visited by bats and moths, then fall by morning. The fruit that follows is a flattened green berry with the old flower parts still attached, which gives the tree its English name.
about.sw:
Mlilana ni mti wa takriban mita 10 wenye majani ya mviringo na kiasi manene. Kuzunguka chini yake huchomoza msitu wa mizizi minene ya kupumulia yenye umbo la koni, ikitoka kwenye tope na maji, minene na mirefu zaidi kuliko ile ya mchu.

Maua yake ni mandhari yanayostahili kuchelewa kuyaona. Ni vishada vyeupe vya stamini ndefu kama pamba ya poda vinavyochanua usiku na kutembelewa na popo na nondo, kisha hupukutika kufikia asubuhi. Tunda linalofuata ni beri bapa ya kijani ambayo bado imeshikilia sehemu za ua la zamani, na hilo ndilo linaloupa mti jina lake la Kiingereza.
about.dg:
*Mangrove apple* ni muhi wa phephi mita 10 wenye makodza ga mviringo na maziho chidide. Kanda-kanda ya kolore kunatuluka mizi minji miziho ya kuphahira pumuzi, yenye umbo dza koni, inayotuluka kula matopeni na madzini; ni miziho na mire kuriko ya *mudzwi*.

Maruwage ni chitu chinono cha kulola hata uchikaa hadi usiku. Ni mafungu ga nyuzi nyereru mire (*stamens*) ganayovugula usiku, na nundu na popho a usiku anaphiya kpwago, chisha ganagbwa kabla ya ligundzu. Tunda rinalotuluka badaye ni bapa, ra chijani, na seemu za ruwa ra kare zichiri dzuluye, na ndiro rinaropha muhi uhu dzina ra Chingereza.

where.en: This is the mangrove that faces the sea. It grows on the outermost seaward fringe in normal seawater, where the tide covers it every day; it fringes Sii Island at Vanga. On a boat trip into Gazi Bay or out from Funzi and Vanga, these are the first trees you pass. The breathing roots are best seen at low tide.
where.sw: Huu ndio mkoko unaoelekea bahari. Huota kwenye ukingo wa nje kabisa upande wa bahari katika maji ya kawaida ya bahari, ambapo maji kujaa huufunika kila siku; huzunguka Kisiwa cha Sii huko Vanga. Ukisafiri kwa mashua kuingia Ghuba ya Gazi au kutoka Funzi na Vanga, hii ndiyo miti ya kwanza utakayoipita. Mizizi ya kupumulia huonekana vizuri zaidi wakati wa maji kupwa.
where.dg: Uhu ndio mkoko unaolola bahari. Unamera kanda ya kure zaidi ya uphande wa bahari, kpwenye madzi ga bahari ga kawaida, ambapho madzi ga kuodzala ganaufwinika chila siku; unazunguluka chisiwa cha Sii, Vanga. Uchiphiya na dau kahi ya Gazi, au kula Funzi na Vanga, hino ndiyo mihi ya mwandzo undayoitsupa. Mizi ya kuphahira pumuzi inaonekana vinono zaidi wakati wa madzi ga kala.

uses.en:
The wood is used for canoes, boat ribs, masts and paddles, as well as door and window frames and charcoal. The breathing roots are light and spongy, and fishermen use them as floats for fishing nets.

The bark yields tannin, and the leaves are fed to camels where they are kept.
uses.sw:
Mbao zake hutumika kwa mitumbwi, mbavu za vyombo, milingoti na makasia, pamoja na fremu za milango na madirisha na mkaa. Mizizi ya kupumulia ni myepesi na kama sponji, na wavuvi huitumia kama vielelezo vya nyavu za kuvulia.

Gome hutoa tanini, na majani hulishwa ngamia pale wanapofugwa.
uses.dg:
Mbao nkuhumirwa kuhenda ngarawa, mbavu za madau, milingoti na makasiya, na piya vizingiti vya miryango na madirisha na makala. Mizi ya kuphahira pumuzi ni phepheya na ni dza sifongo, na avuvi anaihumira ili vimiya vielee.

Gophare rinalavya tanini, na makodza nkurisa ngamia phatu anaphofugbwa.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili it is *mlilana*. In English it is the mangrove apple or white-flowered apple mangrove, and its scientific name is *Sonneratia alba*, where *alba* means white, for the flowers.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mlilana*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *mangrove apple* au *white-flowered apple mangrove*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Sonneratia alba*, ambapo *alba* ina maana ya nyeupe, kwa sababu ya maua yake.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo taridzangbweandikpwa. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mlilana*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *mangrove apple* au *white-flowered apple mangrove*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Sonneratia alba*; manage ga *alba* ni 'nyereru', kpwa sababu ya maruwage.

conservation.en: It is globally Least Concern, but Kenya's mangroves are heavily cut for poles and fuel; harvesting is licensed by the Kenya Forest Service, and community projects at Gazi, Makongeni and Vanga are restoring mangrove forest.
conservation.sw: Kimataifa uko katika hali ya Wasiwasi Mdogo (Least Concern), lakini mikoko ya Kenya hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya boriti na nishati; uvunaji hupewa leseni na Shirika la Misitu la Kenya (Kenya Forest Service), na miradi ya kijamii huko Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga inarejesha misitu ya mikoko.
conservation.dg: Duniani tauri hatarini, ela mikoko ya Kenya inakatwa sana kpwa nguzo na kuni, kpwa hivyo kuikata kunahitaji leseni ya Kenya Forest Service; na mipango ya jamii ya Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga inauyiza matsaka ga mikoko.

reason.en: Also grows on the seaward fringe, with pencil-like breathing roots
reason.sw: Nao pia huota ukingoni upande wa bahari, ukiwa na mizizi ya kupumulia kama penseli
reason.dg: Nao piya unamera kanda ya uphande wa bahari, na una mizi ya kuphahira pumuzi dza kalamu

reason.en: Stands just behind it in the seaward mangrove
reason.sw: Husimama nyuma yake tu katika mikoko ya upande wa bahari
reason.dg: Unaima nyuma ya mkoko uhu kahi ya mikoko ya uphande wa bahari

reason.en: Also used for masts and boat parts
reason.sw: Nao pia hutumika kwa milingoti na sehemu za vyombo
reason.dg: Nao piya unahumirwa kpwa milingoti na vipande vya madau

reason.en: A relative in the same loosestrife family (Lythraceae)
reason.sw: Ndugu katika familia moja ya Lythraceae
